Apasa PORNESTE, apoi in 10 secunde intra in joc (sau intr-un benchmark gratuit, de ex. Unigine Superposition) si joaca normal. Press START, then within 10 seconds switch to your game (or a free benchmark such as Unigine Superposition) and play normally. Measuring is done with Intel's PresentMon (no injection into the game, works with anti-cheat). On first use PresentMon (about 1 MB) is downloaded from Intel's GitHub and its SHA256 signature is verified.

Steadier frame pacing. Reverts by itself after the game. Full effect with Optional: Windows 11 global timer (FPS BOOST).

Opreste Energy Efficient Ethernet, Green Ethernet si oprirea placii de catre Windows pentru economie. Ajuta mai ales pe laptopuri. Conexiunea se reia cateva secunde la aplicare. REVINO pune totul la loc.

Turns off Energy Efficient Ethernet, Green Ethernet and Windows turning the adapter off to save power. Helps mostly on laptops. The connection drops for a few seconds when applied. RESTORE puts everything back.
Opreste Multiplane Overlay. Foloseste-l DOAR daca ai flicker, ecran negru scurt sau stutter. Necesita restart.
Turns off Multiplane Overlay. Use it ONLY if you get flicker, brief black screens or stutter. Restart required.
Opreste Startup Boost si rularea in fundal dupa ce inchizi Edge: mai putin RAM si CPU folosit degeaba.
Turns off Startup Boost and background running after you close Edge: less RAM and CPU wasted.
Opreste popup-ul de pornire al Game Bar si deschiderea lui cu butonul Xbox al controllerului.
Turns off the Game Bar startup pop-up and opening it with the controller Xbox button.
Opreste preincarcarea aplicatiilor in RAM. Pe SSD castigul de viteza e mic, dar scade activitatea pe disc si RAM-ul ocupat.
Stops preloading apps into RAM. On an SSD the speed gain is small, but disk activity and RAM use go down.
Opreste securitatea bazata pe virtualizare. Pe unele PC-uri da 5-10% FPS in plus. Nu opreste Hyper-V sau WSL. Daca e blocat din UEFI, setarea nu are efect.
Turns off virtualization-based security. On some PCs this gives 5-10% more FPS. It does not turn off Hyper-V or WSL. If it is locked in UEFI, the setting has no effect.

Optional: MSI mode for the graphics card

Optional: no drivers through Windows Update

PCIe Link State + USB suspend off (less lag)
Performance > Tuning: undervolt automat pentru temperaturi si consum mai mici la aceleasi frecvente. Testeaza stabilitatea in jocuri dupa.
Performance > Tuning: automatic undervolt for lower temperatures and power at the same clocks. Test stability in games afterwards.
Ping mai mic in jocurile care folosesc TCP (MMO, FiveM). Nu schimba FPS-ul.
Lower ping in games that use TCP (MMO, FiveM). Does not change FPS.
Placa de retea fara economie de energie (fara varfuri de ping)
Network adapter without power saving (no ping spikes)

Placa video foloseste Message Signaled Interrupts: latenta mai mica la intreruperi. Multe drivere noi il au deja pornit. Necesita restart. Daca apare ecran negru, porneste in Safe Mode si apasa REVINO.
The graphics card uses Message Signaled Interrupts: lower interrupt latency. Many recent drivers already enable it. Restart required. If you get a black screen, boot into Safe Mode and press RESTORE.
Placa video lucreaza la maxim: e componenta care limiteaza FPS-ul, ceea ce e normal si ideal in jocuri. Pentru FPS mai mare: setari grafice mai mici, rezolutie mai mica sau upscaling (DLSS / FSR).
The graphics card is maxed out: it is the component limiting FPS, which is normal and ideal in games. For higher FPS: lower graphics settings, a lower resolution or upscaling (DLSS / FSR).

Pushes every component to 100%: the CPU on one core and on all cores, RAM, the system disk (real writes and reads, no cache) and the graphics card (fullscreen DirectX 3D scene with shader effects, 20 s). Takes about 1 minute. Close games and heavy apps first. ESC stops the graphics test.
